research_points.description: Research Points (RP) measure applied scientific work. Operational Research Labs generate RP and assigned labs apply that RP directly to active projects.
research_points.reason: Scientific effort is generated continuously; civilizations should not bank centuries of generic points and instantly complete a newly discovered field.
research_points.unassigned_lab_behavior: Unassigned lab capacity contributes to basic science, field competence, hypothesis generation, and low-rate exploratory research rather than being completely wasted.

research_labs.description: Research Labs are effective research-capacity units. Early-game facilities can contribute one unit each; later institutes, orbital laboratories, specialized complexes, machine research systems, or alien equivalents may contribute multiple effective units without requiring thousands of individually simulated buildings.
research_labs.multiple_simultaneous_projects: allowed whenever enough unreserved effective lab capacity exists to satisfy every active project's minimum lab requirement
research_labs.reason: Concurrency should emerge from physical research capacity rather than an arbitrary research-slot cap.

research_pressure.description: Research Pressure is contextual need/evidence, separate from RP. Certain technologies require one or more pressure values to reach a threshold before the civilization recognizes them as an investigable project.
research_pressure.decay_rule: Pressure decays gradually when the underlying condition disappears unless persistent evidence/history keeps it relevant.
research_pressure.sources: Actual conditions such as shortages, losses, health burdens, strategic performance gaps, hazards, observed foreign capabilities, and scientific evidence.
research_pressure.rubber_band_rule: No artificial catch-up bonus. A weaker civilization can naturally acquire higher pressure from real problems while a dominant civilization can become less urgent or more complacent if it sees no credible need.

foundation.description: Well-understood extensions of established science; often visible through ordinary scientific development without a crisis.

developing.description: Substantial programs requiring multiple research teams or strong evidence/need.

advanced.description: Large coordinated scientific/engineering efforts with significant infrastructure demands.

frontier.description: Civilization-scale frontier research such as mature FTL, megastructure science, or technologies requiring entirely new physics/engineering.

cost_formula.description: Seed formula for data validation and early balancing; exact values are not a commercial-balance lock.

lab_scaling.description: More laboratories can accelerate a project, but coordination and duplicated work create realistic diminishing returns. There is no arbitrary hard cap; very large programs simply become increasingly inefficient.

availability_rules.pressure_gated: If a node has an explicit pressure requirement, the relevant pressure threshold must be met before it becomes Investigable unless an alternate evidence/discovery rule explicitly bypasses that gate.
availability_rules.basic_science: Nodes exposed through basic science may become Hypothesized/Investigable without a practical pressure threshold when prerequisite knowledge and laboratory requirements are satisfied.
availability_rules.evidence_gated: Foreign/anomaly nodes can require evidence tokens regardless of pressure.
availability_rules.lab_gated: A technology may be known/hypothesized but cannot enter active research until the civilization can assign at least the minimum labs required by its complexity/default or node override.
availability_rules.prerequisite_gated: All prerequisite knowledge/capability requirements must still be satisfied.

pressure_threshold_guidance.0: No contextual need required; ordinary basic science can expose the project.
pressure_threshold_guidance.40: Serious strategic, environmental, medical, industrial, or scientific need.
pressure_threshold_guidance.60: Major or sustained civilization-level pressure or compelling evidence.
pressure_threshold_guidance.80: Extreme/existential pressure; reserved for special public technologies or crisis-driven programs, not a generic late-game tax.

early_game_ui.pressure_display_policy: Show the relevant pressure only once the civilization has enough knowledge to recognize the problem/field. Do not expose hidden future branches through UI meters.
early_game_ui.auto_allocation: Starting a project can auto-assign the recommended number of currently available labs, falling back to the minimum if capacity is limited. The player can reallocate manually.
